mapper.insert: INSERT INTO observation (report_id, original_name, original_value, result_kind, numeric_value, unit_text, reference_text, reference_low, reference_high, abnormal_flag, examination_date, confidence, confirmed_at, source_photo_id, status, row_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{originalName}, #{originalValue}, #{resultKind}, #{numericValue}, #{unitText}, #{referenceText}, #{referenceLow}, #{referenceHigh}, #{abnormalFlag}, #{examinationDate}, #{confidence}, #{confirmedAt}, #{sourcePhotoId}, #{status}, #{rowOrder}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id, original_name, original_value, result_kind, numeric_value, unit_text, reference_text, reference_low, reference_high, abnormal_flag, examination_date, confidence, confirmed_at, source_photo_id, status, row_order, created_at, updated_at FROM observation WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY row_order, id
mapper.update: UPDATE observation SET original_name = #{originalName}, original_value = #{originalValue}, result_kind = #{resultKind}, numeric_value = #{numericValue}, unit_text = #{unitText}, reference_text = #{referenceText}, reference_low = #{referenceLow}, reference_high = #{referenceHigh}, abnormal_flag = #{abnormalFlag}, confidence = #{confidence}, row_order = #{rowOrder}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM observation WHERE id = #{id} AND report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
